report.explanation: Operator hypothesis of a faulty deployment causing checkout errors is not supported by current telemetry. All sampled checkout traces return 200 OK across order, payment, and inventory. Order metrics show v1.0.0 serving /v1/orders at 200 with zero 502s; v2.0.0 has no traffic. Deployment record only proves baseline v1.0.0 exists. No current evidence establishes a bounded root cause; logs were excluded, so hand off.
missing_evidence: Checkout error logs/error-rate metrics showing actual failures; current traces show only 200 OK responses
Order service logs (ev-...-order-logs) excluded from context; needed to confirm or refute deployment fault
Gateway logs (ev-...-gateway-logs) excluded; needed to locate error origin
Deployment history for order v2.0.0 (only baseline v1.0.0 record present); v2.0.0 shows zero traffic
